sv3pt5-156.textz: 查看自己牌库上方8张卡。可以从其中选择任意数量的宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。将剩余的卡放回牌库并重洗。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv3pt5-157.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard a Basic Energy card from their hand in order to draw a card. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv3pt5-157.textz: 在各自的回合，双方玩家都可以各1次：将1张手牌中的基本能量卡丢弃，从牌库抽出1张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv3pt5-158.text: Draw 2 cards. Look at your face-down Prize cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv3pt5-158.textz: 从牌库抽出2张卡。查看自己反面朝上的奖赏卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv3pt5-159.text: Flip a coin. If heads, attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv3pt5-159.textz: 掷1次硬币。若为正面，则从自己的弃牌区选择1张基本能量卡，附于自己的1只备战宝可梦身上。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv3pt5-160.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put a Basic Pokémon you find there onto your opponent's Bench. If you put a Pokémon onto their Bench in this way, switch in that Pokémon to the Active Spot. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv3pt5-160.textz: 对手公开手牌，从其中选择1张基础宝可梦，放置于对手的备战区。若以这种方式放置了宝可梦，则将那只宝可梦与对手的战斗宝可梦互换。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv3pt5-161.text: Put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand. If you do, attach an Energy card from your hand to your Active Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv3pt5-161.textz: 将对手战斗宝可梦身上附加的1个能量放回对手的手牌。若这么做，则将自己手牌中的1张能量卡附于自己的战斗宝可梦身上。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv3pt5-162.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put a Pokémon you find there on the bottom of their deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv3pt5-162.textz: 对手公开手牌，从其中选择1张宝可梦，放回对手的牌库下方。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv3pt5-163.text: At the end of your turn, if the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, heal 20 damage from it. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
sv3pt5-163.textz: 在自己的回合结束时，若附有这张卡的宝可梦在战斗场上，则将它恢复「20」HP。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

sv3pt5-164.text: The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to has no Weakness. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat.

me5-77.text:
You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand.
During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box do 80 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V_atk, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

me5-78.text: Discard up to 2 Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box from your hand, and draw 3 cards for each card you discarded in this way. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V_atk, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
me5-78.textz: 从自己的手牌将最多2张没有规则框的宝可梦丢弃，每丢弃1张就从牌库抽出3张卡。（宝可梦ex、宝可梦V等拥有规则框。）

me4-75.text:
You can put this card into play only if you discard a Prism Tower in play, and you can put this card into play during the same turn you play Prism Tower.
Each Mega Floette ex in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +150 HP.
me4-75.textz: 只有将场上的「棱镜塔」丢弃，才可以使用这张卡；在使出「棱镜塔」的同一回合也可以使用。场上所有超级花洁夫人ex（不论敌我）的最大HP增加「150」。

me4-76.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you moved a Pokémon ex to your Bench in this way, heal 80 damage from that Pokémon.
me4-76.textz: 将自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。若以这种方式将宝可梦ex换到了备战区，则将那只宝可梦恢复「80」HP。

me4-77.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you draw a card for each Pokémon you find there.
me4-77.textz: 对手公开手牌，其中每有1张宝可梦，自己就从牌库抽出1张卡。

me4-78.text:
Choose 1 or both:
• Shuffle up to 3 Water Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.
• Shuffle up to 3 Basic Water Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
me4-78.textz: 选择其中1项或2项：• 从自己的弃牌区选择最多3张【水】宝可梦，放回牌库并重洗。• 从自己的弃牌区选择最多3张「基本【水】能量」卡，放回牌库并重洗。

me4-79.text: Attach up to 2 Basic Metal Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Metal Pokémon.
me4-79.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择最多2张「基本【钢】能量」卡，附于自己的1只【钢】宝可梦身上。

me4-80.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard 2 cards from their hand in order to draw a card.
me4-80.textz: 在各自的回合，双方玩家都可以各1次：将2张手牌丢弃，从牌库抽出1张卡。

me4-81.text: During your opponent's next turn, their Poisoned Pokémon can't retreat. (This includes newly Poisoned Pokémon.)
me4-81.textz: 在下个对手的回合，对手【中毒】的宝可梦无法撤退。（包括之后才【中毒】的宝可梦。）

me4-82.text:
You can use this card only if your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining.

Your opponent shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 3 cards.
me4-82.textz: 只有在对手剩余的奖赏卡为3张以下时，才可以使用这张卡。对手将自己的手牌重洗后，放回牌库下方。若以这种方式将卡放回了牌库下方，则那位玩家从牌库抽出3张卡。

me4-83.text:
You must play 2 Transformation Tome cards at once. (This effect works one time for 2 cards.)
 
Choose a Basic Pokémon in your discard pile and switch it with 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.
me4-83.textz: 必须同时使用2张「变身秘籍」。（2张卡只发挥1次效果。）从自己的弃牌区选择1张基础宝可梦，与自己场上的1只基础宝可梦交换。附加的卡、伤害指示物、特殊状态、登场的回合数以及其他效果，全部由新的宝可梦继承。

me4-84.text:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Water Energy.

The Water Pokémon this card is attached to recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.
me4-84.textz: 只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为1个【水】能量。附有这张卡的【水】宝可梦从所有特殊状态中恢复，且不会陷入特殊状态。

me4-85.text:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Metal Energy.

The Metal Pokémon this card is attached to has no Retreat Cost.
me4-85.textz: 只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为1个【钢】能量。附有这张卡的【钢】宝可梦撤退时不需要能量。

me4-86.text:
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Fire Energy.
 
If this card is discarded by an effect of an attack used by the Fire Pokémon this card is attached to, put this card into your hand after attack damage and effects.
me4-86.textz: 只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为1个【火】能量。若这张卡因附有它的【火】宝可梦所使用招式的效果而被丢弃，则在招式的伤害和效果结束后，将这张卡加入手牌。

me3-76.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me3-76.textz: 双方玩家各自将手牌放回牌库并重洗，然后各抽出4张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me3-77.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. If a player searches their deck in this way, their turn ends. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.
me3-77.textz: 在各自的回合，双方玩家都可以各1次：从牌库选择1张基础宝可梦，放置于备战区。然后，那位玩家重洗牌库。若玩家以这种方式检索了牌库，则那位玩家的回合结束。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me3-78.text: Heal 20 damage and remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me3-78.textz: 将自己的战斗宝可梦恢复「20」HP，并消除1种特殊状态。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me3-79.text: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. Before drawing cards, you may discard any number of cards from your hand. (If you can't draw any cards in this way, you can't use this card.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me3-79.textz: 从牌库抽卡，直到自己的手牌变成5张为止。抽卡前，可以从自己的手牌将任意张卡丢弃。（若无法以这种方式抽卡，则无法使用这张卡。）在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me3-80.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me3-80.textz: 掷1次硬币。若为正面，则从自己的牌库选择1张宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me3-81.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me3-81.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张没有规则框的宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。（宝可梦ex、宝可梦V等拥有规则框。）在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me3-82.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me3-82.textz: 掷1次硬币。若为正面，则选择1只对手的备战宝可梦，与战斗宝可梦互换。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me3-83.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me3-83.textz: 将自己的1只宝可梦恢复「30」HP。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me3-84.text: You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.  Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me3-84.textz: 只有在自己剩余的奖赏卡比对手多时，才可以使用这张卡。从自己的弃牌区选择最多2张基本能量卡，附于自己的1只2阶进化宝可梦身上。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me3-85.text: Put up to 4 in any combination of Fighting Pokémon and Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me3-85.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择【斗】宝可梦和「基本【斗】能量」卡合计最多4张，加入手牌。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me3-86.text: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Grass Energy. The Grass Pokémon this card is attached to gets +20 HP.
me3-86.textz: 只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为1个【草】能量。附有这张卡的【草】宝可梦最大HP增加「20」。

me3-87.text: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Fighting Energy. Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to the Fighting Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)
me3-87.textz: 只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为1个【斗】能量。附有这张卡的【斗】宝可梦不会受到对手宝可梦招式的效果影响。（已经受到的效果不会消除。伤害不算效果。）

me3-88.text: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Psychic Energy. When you attach this card from your hand to a Psychic Pokémon, search your deck for up to 2 Basic Psychic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
me3-88.textz: 只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为1个【超】能量。从手牌将这张卡附于【超】宝可梦身上时，从自己的牌库选择最多2张【超】基础宝可梦，放置于备战区。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币若为正面，则在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦不会受到招式的伤害与效果的影响。

attacks.t: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择1张宝可梦卡，在给对手看过后加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合可使用1次。掷1次硬币。若为正面，则随机选择对手的1张手牌，将其丢弃。

abilities.t: All of your Pokémon that have any Water Energy attached take 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). The effect of Tundra Wall doesn't stack.
abilities.tz: 自己身上附有【水】能量的宝可梦，受到对手宝可梦招式的伤害全部减少50点（计算弱点和抗性后）。「冻原之壁」的效果不会重复叠加。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，受到这个招式的宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.t: Choose Basic Lightning Energy cards from your discard pile up to the amount of Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon and attach them to your Lightning Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.tz: 从自己的弃牌区选择「基本【雷】能量」卡，最多与对手所有宝可梦身上附加的能量数量相同，以任意方式附于自己的【雷】宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币若为正面，则将对手的战斗宝可梦【麻痹】。

attacks.t: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
attacks.tz: 选择1只对手的备战宝可梦，与战斗宝可梦互换。

attacks.t: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦恢复「20」HP。

attacks.t: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择3个这只宝可梦身上附加的能量，将其丢弃。

attacks.t: This Pokémon also does 70 damage to itself. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.
attacks.tz: 这只宝可梦也受到70点伤害。将对手的战斗宝可梦【麻痹】并【中毒】。

attacks.t: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 在造成伤害前，将对手的战斗宝可梦身上附加的「宝可梦道具」卡丢弃。

attacks.t: This attack does 40 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Rattata.
attacks.tz: 造成自己所有备战「小拉达」身上伤害指示物数量×40点伤害。

abilities.t: If your opponent has exactly 4 cards in their hand, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 若对手的手牌正好为4张，则这只宝可梦使用招式所需的【无色】能量全部不需要。

attacks.t: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择1个对手的战斗宝可梦身上附加的能量，将其丢弃。

attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择最多2张卡，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.t: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Dark Strike.

Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Ability that has "Last-Ditch" in its name each turn.

attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦与附加的卡，全部放回手牌。

me2pt5-186.text: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to cost Colorless less. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
me2pt5-186.textz: 若自己剩余的奖赏卡比对手多，则附有这张卡的宝可梦使用招式所需能量减少1个【无色】。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

me2pt5-187.text: Search your deck for a Basic Fighting Energy card or a Basic Fighting Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-187.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张「基本【斗】能量」卡或【斗】基础宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-188.text: Each player's Grass Pokémon can evolve into Grass Pokémon during the turn they play those Pokémon, except during their first turn. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.
me2pt5-188.textz: 双方的【草】宝可梦，在登场的回合也可以进化成【草】宝可梦（各自最初的回合除外）。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me2pt5-189.text: You can use this card only if you have any Tera Pokémon in play.  Choose up to 2 of your Benched Colorless Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-189.textz: 只有在自己场上有太晶宝可梦时，才可以使用这张卡。选择自己最多2只【无色】备战宝可梦，从弃牌区各选择1张基本能量卡附于其身上。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-190.text: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.  Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2pt5-190.textz: 必须将自己的另外1张手牌丢弃，才可以使用这张卡。从牌库抽卡，直到自己的手牌变成6张为止。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2pt5-191.text: Attacks used by the Pikachu ex this card is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
me2pt5-191.textz: 附有这张卡的皮卡丘ex使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦ex造成的伤害增加50点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

me2pt5-192.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2pt5-192.textz: 将自己的手牌全部放回牌库并重洗。然后，从牌库抽出6张卡。若自己剩余的奖赏卡正好为6张，则改为抽出8张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2pt5-193.text: Search your deck for a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-193.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张超级进化宝可梦ex，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-194.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard an Energy card from their hand in order to draw cards until they have as many cards in their hand as they have Psychic Pokémon in play. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.
me2pt5-194.textz: 在各自的回合，双方玩家都可以各1次：将1张手牌中的能量卡丢弃，从牌库抽卡，直到手牌张数与自己场上的【超】宝可梦数量相同为止。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me2pt5-195.text: Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched N's Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-195.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择1张基本能量卡，附于自己的1只「N的」备战宝可梦身上。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-196.text: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-196.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择1张宝可梦或基本能量卡，加入手牌。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-197.text: Attacks used by each Tera Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) cost Colorless more. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.
me2pt5-197.textz: 场上所有太晶宝可梦（不论敌我）使用招式所需能量增加1个【无色】。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me2pt5-198.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-198.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张没有规则框的宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。（宝可梦ex、宝可梦V等拥有规则框。）在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-199.text: During this turn, attacks used by your Fighting Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-199.textz: 在这个回合，自己的【斗】宝可梦使用的招式对对手战斗宝可梦造成的伤害增加30点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-200.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2pt5-200.textz: 将自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。若这么做，则从牌库抽卡，直到自己的手牌变成5张为止。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2pt5-201.text: You can use this card only if any of your Team Rocket's Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.  Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2pt5-201.textz: 只有在上一个对手的回合，自己的火箭队的宝可梦【昏厥】过，才可以使用这张卡。双方玩家各自将手牌放回牌库并重洗。然后，自己抽出5张卡，对手抽出3张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2pt5-202.text: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If all of your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket's Pokémon, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2pt5-202.textz: 从牌库抽卡，直到自己的手牌变成5张为止。若自己场上的宝可梦全部都是火箭队的宝可梦，则改为抽卡直到手牌变成8张为止。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2pt5-203.text: Once during each player's turn, if they played a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name from their hand this turn, they may draw 2 cards. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.
me2pt5-203.textz: 在各自的回合，若那位玩家在这个回合从手牌使出了名字带有「火箭队」的支持者卡，则可以各1次从牌库抽出2张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me2pt5-204.text: Switch your Active Team Rocket's Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Team Rocket's Pokémon. If you do, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2pt5-204.textz: 将自己的火箭队的战斗宝可梦与火箭队的备战宝可梦互换。若这么做，则选择1只对手的备战宝可梦，与战斗宝可梦互换。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2pt5-205.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-205.textz: 掷1次硬币。若为正面，则从自己的牌库选择1张火箭队的进化宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。若为反面，则从自己的牌库选择1张火箭队的基础宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-206.text: If the Team Rocket's Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Team Rocket's Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
me2pt5-206.textz: 若附有这张卡的火箭队的宝可梦在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦招式的伤害（即使【昏厥】），则令攻击方的宝可梦【睡眠】。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

me2pt5-207.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2pt5-207.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张训练家卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2pt5-208.text: If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.  Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2pt5-208.textz: 若自己是先攻，在最初的回合也可以使用这张卡。从自己的牌库选择最多3张火箭队的基础宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2pt5-209.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-209.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张名字带有「火箭队」的支持者卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-210.text: Colorless Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can’t be played.
me2pt5-210.textz: 场上的【无色】宝可梦（不论敌我）的特性全部消除。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me2pt5-211.text: The Dragon Pokémon this card is attached to takes 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Grass, Fire, Water, or Lightning Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
me2pt5-211.textz: 附有这张卡的【龙】宝可梦，受到对手【草】【火】【水】【雷】宝可梦招式的伤害减少50点（计算弱点和抗性后）。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

me2pt5-212.text: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) and discard them. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-212.textz: 选择最多2张附于宝可梦（不论敌我）身上的宝可梦道具，将其丢弃。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-213.text: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand. Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2pt5-213.textz: 必须将自己的另外2张手牌丢弃，才可以使用这张卡。从自己的牌库选择1张宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2pt5-214.text: Draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2pt5-214.textz: 从牌库抽出3张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2pt5-215.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach a Basic Energy card you find there to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2pt5-215.textz: 查看自己牌库上方6张卡，从其中选择1张基本能量卡，附于自己的1只宝可梦身上。将剩余的卡放回牌库并重洗。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2pt5-216.text: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.  If this card is attached to a Basic Pokémon, this card provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time.
me2pt5-216.textz: 只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为1个【无色】能量。若这张卡附于基础宝可梦身上，则视为所有属性的能量，但每次只视为1个能量。

me2pt5-217.text: This card can only be attached to a Team Rocket's Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Rocket's Pokémon, discard this card.  As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides 2 in any combination of Psychic Energy and Darkness Energy.
me2pt5-217.textz: 这张卡只能附于火箭队的宝可梦身上。若这张卡附于火箭队的宝可梦以外的宝可梦身上，则将这张卡丢弃。只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为【超】能量和【恶】能量任意组合的2个能量。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for an Erika's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合可使用1次。从自己的牌库选择1张「莉佳的」宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币若为正面，则将对手的战斗宝可梦【麻痹】。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币若为正面，则将对手的战斗宝可梦【麻痹】。

attacks.t: Your opponent reveals their hand, and this attack does 80 damage for each Energy card you find there.
attacks.tz: 对手公开手牌，造成其中能量卡张数×80点伤害。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合可使用1次。掷1次硬币。若为正面，则将对手战斗宝可梦身上附加的1个能量放回对手的手牌。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【睡眠】并【中毒】。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，对手无法从手牌使出物品卡。

abilities.t: If this Pokémon has no Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.
abilities.tz: 若这只宝可梦身上没有附加能量卡，则这只宝可梦【撤退】所需的能量全部消除。

attacks.t: Discard up to 5 Fire Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
attacks.tz: 将最多5张这只宝可梦身上附加的【火】能量卡丢弃，造成其张数×70点伤害。

abilities.t: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.
abilities.tz: 若这只宝可梦在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦招式的伤害（即使这只宝可梦【昏厥】），则令攻击方的宝可梦【灼伤】。

attacks.t: Your opponent discards a card from their hand. If this Pokémon evolved from Salandit during this turn, your opponent discards 2 more cards.
attacks.tz: 对手选择对手自己的1张手牌，将其丢弃。在这个回合，若这只宝可梦从「夜盗火蜥」进化，则再丢弃2张。

attacks.t: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择1个这只宝可梦身上附加的能量，将其丢弃。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币若为正面，则增加10点伤害。

abilities.t: Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) lose any Ability that requires the Pokémon using it to Knock Out itself.
abilities.tz: 场上的宝可梦（不论敌我）中，需要令自己【昏厥】才能使用的特性全部消除。

attacks.t: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上附加的能量卡全部丢弃，将对手的战斗宝可梦【麻痹】。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, if you played Canari from your hand this turn, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.tz: 若在这个回合从手牌使出了「卡娜莉」，则在自己的回合可使用1次。从自己的牌库选择最多2张「基本【雷】能量」卡，附于这只宝可梦身上。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.
attacks.tz: 这只宝可梦身上每附加1个能量，就掷1次硬币。造成正面次数×70点伤害。

attacks.t: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Lightning Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦与备战区的【雷】宝可梦互换。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币若为正面，则增加20点伤害。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币若为正面，则在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦不会受到招式的伤害与效果的影响。

attacks.t: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择1张从这只宝可梦进化而来的卡，放置于这只宝可梦身上完成进化。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Your opponent chooses 3 cards from their hand and shuffles those cards into their deck.
attacks.tz: 对手选择3张对手自己的手牌，放回牌库并重洗。

abilities.t: When your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out, flip a coin. If heads, take 1 more Prize card. The effect of Wonder Kiss doesn't stack.
abilities.tz: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，每次当对手的战斗宝可梦【昏厥】时，自己掷1次硬币。若为正面，则多获得1张奖赏卡。无论有多少只拥有这个特性的宝可梦，这个效果也不会重复。

attacks.t: If any of your Hop's Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 100 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若在上个对手的回合，自己「赫普的」宝可梦因招式的伤害而【昏厥】过，则增加100点伤害。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，受到这个招式的宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.t: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Tera Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
attacks.tz: 选择对手的太晶战斗宝可梦拥有的1个招式，作为这个招式使用。

abilities.t: Whenever your opponent's Active Pokémon moves to the Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 每当对手的战斗宝可梦在对手的回合移动到备战区时，在那只宝可梦身上放置2个伤害指示物。

abilities.t: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.tz: 这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害「-30」点。

attacks.t: Discard up to 2 Energy cards from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage for each card you discarded in this way.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上最多2张能量卡丢弃，造成丢弃张数×120点伤害。

me2-41.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me2-41.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择1张【基础】宝可梦卡，放置于备战区。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦恢复「10」HP。

attacks.t: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.
attacks.tz: 造成自己场上宝可梦数量×20点伤害。

attacks.t: If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若对手剩余的奖赏卡为3张以下，则增加90点伤害。

attacks.t: Place 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 在对手的1只宝可梦身上放置1个伤害指示物。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Make your opponent's Active Pokémon Confused.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌使出这张卡并完成进化时，可使用1次。令对手的战斗宝可梦【混乱】。

attacks.t: This attack does 40 damage for each of your Pokémon that has "Tauros" in its name that has any damage counters on it.
attacks.tz: 自己名字带有「肯泰罗」且身上放置有伤害指示物的宝可梦每有1只，就造成40点伤害。

attacks.t: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
attacks.tz: 这只宝可梦也受到20点伤害。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【中毒】。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【中毒】。在下个对手的回合，那只宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.t: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
attacks.tz: 掷2次硬币，造成正面出现的次数×10点伤害。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. You may also use this Ability if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon. Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌使出这张卡并完成进化时，可使用1次。这只宝可梦在战斗场上因对手宝可梦招式的伤害而【昏厥】时，也可以使用这个特性。将对手牌库上方2张卡丢弃。

abilities.t: If 1 of your Darkness Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, that player takes 1 fewer Prize card. The effect of Shadowy Concealment doesn't stack.
abilities.tz: 若自己的【恶】宝可梦因对手宝可梦ex招式的伤害而【昏厥】，则对手拿取的奖赏卡减少1张。「暗影隐蔽」的效果不会重复叠加。

attacks.t: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择1个这只宝可梦身上附加的能量，改附于备战宝可梦身上。

me2-56.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me2-56.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币若为正面，则增加20点伤害。

attacks.t: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上的2个能量丢弃，给对手的1只宝可梦造成120点伤害。（备战宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.t: If you have any Stage 2 Darkness Pokémon on your Bench, this attack does 70 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若自己的备战区有【恶】2阶进化宝可梦，则增加70点伤害。

attacks.tz: 若这只宝可梦身上放置有伤害指示物，则增加150点伤害。

me2-61.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: If you have any Darkness Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, attacks used by this Pokémon do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.tz: 若自己场上有【恶】超级进化宝可梦ex，则这只宝可梦使用的招式对对手战斗宝可梦造成的伤害增加120点（计算弱点和抗性前）。

attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库抽出2张卡。

attacks.t: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 160 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若在上个对手的回合，自己的宝可梦因招式的伤害而【昏厥】过，则增加160点伤害。

abilities.tz: 在自己的回合可使用1次。从自己的牌库选择1张「基本【恶】能量」卡，附于自己的1只【恶】备战宝可梦身上。并且重洗牌库。若以这种方式将能量附于宝可梦身上，则在那只宝可梦身上放置2个伤害指示物。

attacks.t: Discard a Stadium in play.
attacks.tz: 将场上的竞技场卡丢弃。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币。若为反面，则在下个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法使用招式。

abilities.t: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon. (Damage is not an effect.)
abilities.tz: 这只宝可梦不会受到对手的宝可梦使用招式的效果的影响。

attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害「-60」点。

me2-70.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币若为正面，则在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦不会受到招式的伤害。

attacks.t: Draw 3 cards.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库抽出3张卡。

attacks.t: This attack does 40 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 造成所有宝可梦身上附加的宝可梦道具数量×40点伤害。

attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择1张宝可梦卡，在给对手看过后加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择1个对手的战斗宝可梦身上附加的能量，将其丢弃。

attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦不会受到【基础】宝可梦招式的伤害。

attacks.tz: 掷硬币直到出现反面为止。造成正面次数×20点伤害。

attacks.tz: 造成自己场上拥有招式「轮唱」的宝可梦数量×40点伤害。

attacks.tz: 随机选择对手的1张手牌，对手公开那张卡，放回牌库并重洗。

attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上的2个能量丢弃，选择对手的2只宝可梦，各造成60点伤害。（备战宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.t: Flip 3 coins. Attach an amount of Basic Energy up to the number of heads from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.tz: 掷3次硬币。从自己的弃牌区选择最多与正面次数相同数量的基本能量，以任意方式附于自己的备战宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
attacks.tz: 这只宝可梦也受到10点伤害。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, and if you have any Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.t: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。

attacks.t: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 170 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若这只宝可梦在这个回合从备战区移动到了战斗场，则增加170点伤害。

me2-85.text: Prevent all damage counters from being placed on Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) by effects of attacks and Abilities from the opponent's Pokémon. (Damage from attacks is still taken.) You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
me2-85.textz: 对方宝可梦的招式和特性的效果，不会在双方的备战宝可梦身上放置伤害指示物。（招式的伤害照常计算。）在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me2-86.text: You can use this card only if you discard a Basic Fire Energy card from your hand.  Discard a Pokémon Tool or Special Energy card from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon, or discard a Stadium in play. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2-86.textz: 必须从手牌将1张「基本【火】能量」卡丢弃，才可以使用这张卡。将对手1只宝可梦身上的1张宝可梦道具或特殊能量卡丢弃，或将场上的竞技场卡丢弃。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2-87.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, a Stage 1 Pokémon, and a Stage 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2-87.textz: 从自己的牌库选择基础宝可梦、1阶进化宝可梦和2阶进化宝可梦各1张，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2-88.text: Confused Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) don't recover from that Special Condition when they evolve or devolve. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
me2-88.textz: 【混乱】的宝可梦（不论敌我）进化或退化时，不会从【混乱】中恢复。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me2-89.text: Search your deck for up to 7 Basic Fire Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2-89.textz: 从自己的牌库选择最多7张「基本【火】能量」卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2-90.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck and put a Darkness Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck. You can't use this card during your first turn. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me2-90.textz: 查看自己牌库上方7张卡，从其中选择1张【恶】宝可梦，放置于备战区。将剩余的卡重洗，放回牌库下方。在自己最初的回合无法使用这张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me2-91.text: Heal 80 damage from your Active Pokémon that has 3 or more Energy attached. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me2-91.textz: 将自己身上附有3个以上能量的战斗宝可梦恢复「80」HP。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me2-92.text: If the Darkness Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
me2-92.textz: 若附有这张卡的【恶】宝可梦在战斗场上受到对手宝可梦招式的伤害（即使这只宝可梦【昏厥】），则在攻击方的宝可梦身上放置4个伤害指示物。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

me2-93.text: The Pokémon this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have an Ability (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
me2-93.textz: 附有这张卡的宝可梦，受到对手拥有特性的宝可梦招式的伤害减少30点（计算弱点和抗性后）。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to that Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon ex. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

me1-117.text: Each player's Grass Pokémon can evolve into Grass Pokémon during the turn they play those Pokémon, except during their first turn. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
me1-117.textz: 双方的【草】宝可梦，在登场的回合也可以进化成【草】宝可梦（各自最初的回合除外）。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me1-121.text: Search your deck for a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-121.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张超级进化宝可梦ex，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-122.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard an Energy card from their hand in order to draw cards until they have as many cards in their hand as they have Psychic Pokémon in play. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
me1-122.textz: 在各自的回合，双方玩家都可以各1次：将1张手牌中的能量卡丢弃，从牌库抽卡，直到手牌张数与自己场上的【超】宝可梦数量相同为止。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me1-123.text: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, and it recovers from all Special Conditions. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me1-123.textz: 将自己的1只宝可梦恢复「60」HP，并从所有特殊状态中恢复。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me1-124.text: During this turn, attacks used by your Fighting Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-124.textz: 在这个回合，自己的【斗】宝可梦使用的招式对对手战斗宝可梦造成的伤害增加30点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-125.text: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-125.textz: 选择自己场上的1只基础宝可梦。若手牌中有从那只宝可梦进化而来的2阶进化卡，则跳过1阶进化，将那张卡放在基础宝可梦身上进化。在自己最初的回合，或对这个回合才登场的基础宝可梦，无法使用这张卡。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-126.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-126.textz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。（由对手选择新的战斗宝可梦。）在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-127.text: Whenever any player puts a Basic non-Darkness Pokémon onto their Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
me1-127.textz: 每当任何玩家在自己的回合将非【恶】的基础宝可梦放置于备战区时，就在那只宝可梦身上放置2个伤害指示物。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me1-128.text: Devolve 1 of your evolved Psychic Pokémon by putting any number of Evolution cards on it into your hand. (That Pokémon can't evolve this turn.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-128.textz: 将自己的1只【超】进化宝可梦身上任意张进化卡加入手牌，令其退化。（那只宝可梦在这个回合无法进化。）在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-129.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may switch their Active Water Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Water Pokémon. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
me1-129.textz: 在各自的回合，双方玩家都可以各1次：将自己的【水】战斗宝可梦与【水】备战宝可梦互换。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me1-130.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-130.textz: 将自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-131.text: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.  Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-131.textz: 必须将自己的另外2张手牌丢弃，才可以使用这张卡。从自己的牌库选择1张宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-132.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me1-132.textz: 将自己的1只超级进化宝可梦ex的HP全部恢复。若以这种方式恢复了HP，则将那只宝可梦身上附加的所有能量加入手牌。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，受到这个招式的宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害「-30」点。

attacks.t: This attack does 30 more damage for each Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 这只宝可梦身上每附加1个【草】能量，就增加30点伤害。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has any Grass Energy attached, you may use this Ability. Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 若这只宝可梦身上附有【草】能量，则在自己的回合可使用1次。将自己的1只宝可梦恢复「30」HP。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for a Shedinja and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌使出这张卡并完成进化时，可使用1次。从自己的牌库选择1张「铁面忍者」，放置于备战区。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from the Active Spot to your Bench, you may use this Ability. Attach up to 2 Basic Water Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，这只宝可梦从战斗场移动到备战区时，可使用1次。从手牌选择最多2张「基本【水】能量」卡，附于这只宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上附加的能量卡全部丢弃。

attacks.t: Choose a Pokémon in play (yours or your opponent's) that has the least HP remaining, except for this Pokémon, and it is Knocked Out.
attacks.tz: 选择场上（不论敌我）剩余HP最少的1只宝可梦（这只宝可梦除外），令它【昏厥】。

attacks.t: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择1个这只宝可梦身上附加的能量，将其丢弃。

attacks.t: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.
attacks.tz: 掷2次硬币，造成正面出现的次数×10点伤害。

abilities.t: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon ex, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.
abilities.tz: 若这只宝可梦因对手宝可梦ex招式的伤害而【昏厥】，则对手无法拿取奖赏卡。

attacks.t: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 造成对手的战斗宝可梦身上放置的伤害指示物的数量×20点伤害。

attacks.t: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals those cards and shuffles them into their deck.
attacks.tz: 掷硬币直到出现反面为止。每出现1次正面，就随机选择对手的1张手牌。对手公开那些卡，放回牌库并重洗。

attacks.t: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 若对手的宝可梦因这个招式的伤害而【昏厥】，则在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦不会受到招式的伤害与效果影响。

abilities.t: Attacks used by your Fighting Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.tz: 自己的【斗】宝可梦使用的招式对对手战斗宝可梦造成的伤害增加30点（计算弱点和抗性前）。

abilities.t: If your Active Darkness Pokémon is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if your Active Darkness Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 1 damage counter on the Attacking Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 若自己的【恶】战斗宝可梦受到对手宝可梦招式的伤害（即使【昏厥】），则在攻击方的宝可梦身上放置1个伤害指示物。

attacks.t: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
attacks.tz: 将对手的牌库上方1张卡丢弃。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【中毒】。

attacks.t: If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 200 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若自己剩余的奖赏卡正好为6张，则增加200点伤害。

attacks.t: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 在造成伤害前，将对手的战斗宝可梦身上附加的「宝可梦道具」卡丢弃。

attacks.t: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库抽出2张卡。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Switch a card from your hand with the top card of your deck.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合可使用1次。将自己的1张手牌与牌库上方1张卡交换。

abilities.t: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a Basic Grass Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合可使用任意次。将自己1只宝可梦身上的1个「基本【草】能量」，转附于自己的另1只宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦恢复「30」HP。

me1-155.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-155.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Burned, this attack does 160 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若对手的战斗宝可梦处于【灼伤】状态，则增加160点伤害。

attacks.t: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择2个这只宝可梦身上附加的能量，将其丢弃。

me1-156.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-156.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Discard the top 6 cards of your deck, and this attack does 100 damage for each Basic Water Energy card that you discarded in this way.
attacks.tz: 将自己牌库上方6张卡丢弃，造成其中「基本【水】能量」卡张数×100点伤害。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害「-30」点。

me1-157.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-157.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦不会受到【基础】宝可梦招式的伤害。

attacks.t: You may discard all Energy from this Pokémon and have this attack do 130 more damage.
attacks.tz: 可以将这只宝可梦身上的所有能量丢弃，增加130点伤害。

me1-158.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-158.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic Psychic Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 自己的每只备战宝可梦，各从牌库选择1张「基本【超】能量」卡附于其身上。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: This attack does 50 damage for each Psychic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 造成自己场上所有宝可梦身上附加的【超】能量数量×50点伤害。

me1-159.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-159.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Attach up to 3 Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.tz: 从自己的弃牌区选择最多3张「基本【斗】能量」卡，以任意方式附于自己的备战宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Mega Brave.
attacks.tz: 在下个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法使用「超级勇气」。

me1-160.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-160.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has exactly 6 damage counters on it, that Pokémon is Knocked Out.
attacks.tz: 若对手战斗宝可梦身上放置的伤害指示物正好为6个，则令那只宝可梦【昏厥】。

attacks.t: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you discard a card you find there.
attacks.tz: 对手公开手牌，从其中选择1张卡丢弃。

me1-161.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-161.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: This attack does 80 damage for each Prize card you have taken.
attacks.tz: 造成自己已拿取的奖赏卡张数×80点伤害。

attacks.t: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack's base damage is 30.
attacks.tz: 若对手的战斗宝可梦身上放置有伤害指示物，则这个招式的基础伤害变为30点。

me1-162.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-162.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 若希望，将这只宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。

attacks.t: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上附加的能量卡全部丢弃。

me1-163.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-163.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Draw 2 cards. You can't use more than 1 Run Errand Ability each turn.
abilities.tz: 若这只宝可梦在战斗场上，则在自己的回合可使用1次。从牌库抽出2张卡。「跑腿」特性每个回合只能使用1次。

attacks.t: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 more damage for each heads.
attacks.tz: 掷硬币直到出现反面，增加正面出现的次数×50点伤害。

me1-164.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-164.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

me1-165.text: You can use this card only if your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining.  Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to that Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon ex. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me1-165.textz: 只有在对手剩余的奖赏卡为2张以下时，才可以使用这张卡。选择自己场上的1只宝可梦。在下个对手的回合，那只宝可梦不会受到对手宝可梦ex招式的伤害与效果影响。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me1-166.text: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is ColorlessColorless less. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
me1-166.textz: 附有这张卡的宝可梦，撤退所需能量减少2个【无色】。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

me1-167.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-167.textz: 从自己的牌库选择最多2张HP70以下的基础宝可梦，放置于备战区。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-168.text: Search your deck for a Basic Fighting Energy card or a Basic Fighting Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-168.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张「基本【斗】能量」卡或【斗】基础宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-169.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me1-169.textz: 将自己的手牌全部放回牌库并重洗。然后，从牌库抽出6张卡。若自己剩余的奖赏卡正好为6张，则改为抽出8张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me1-170.text: Ask your opponent if each player may take a Prize card. If yes, each player takes a Prize card. If no, you draw 4 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me1-170.textz: 询问对手是否双方各拿取1张奖赏卡。若对手同意，则双方各拿取1张奖赏卡。若对手不同意，则自己从牌库抽出4张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me1-171.text: Search your deck for a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-171.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张超级进化宝可梦ex，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-172.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard an Energy card from their hand in order to draw cards until they have as many cards in their hand as they have Psychic Pokémon in play. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
me1-172.textz: 在各自的回合，双方玩家都可以各1次：将1张手牌中的能量卡丢弃，从牌库抽卡，直到手牌张数与自己场上的【超】宝可梦数量相同为止。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

me1-173.text: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-173.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择1张宝可梦或基本能量卡，加入手牌。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-174.text: During this turn, attacks used by your Fighting Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-174.textz: 在这个回合，自己的【斗】宝可梦使用的招式对对手战斗宝可梦造成的伤害增加30点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-175.text: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it, skipping the Stage 1. You can't use this card during your first turn or on a Basic Pokémon that was put into play this turn. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
me1-175.textz: 选择自己场上的1只基础宝可梦。若手牌中有从那只宝可梦进化而来的2阶进化卡，则跳过1阶进化，将那张卡放在基础宝可梦身上进化。在自己最初的回合，或对这个回合才登场的基础宝可梦，无法使用这张卡。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

me1-176.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex. If you healed any damage in this way, put all Energy attached to that Pokémon into your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me1-176.textz: 将自己的1只超级进化宝可梦ex的HP全部恢复。若以这种方式恢复了HP，则将那只宝可梦身上附加的所有能量加入手牌。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

abilities.t: As often as you like during your turn, you may use this Ability. Move a Basic Grass Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合可使用任意次。将自己1只宝可梦身上的1个「基本【草】能量」，转附于自己的另1只宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦恢复「30」HP。

me1-177.rule: Mega Evolution ex Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me1-177.rulez: 超级进化宝可梦ex规则：你的超级进化宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic Psychic Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 自己的每只备战宝可梦，各从牌库选择1张「基本【超】能量」卡附于其身上。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: This attack does 50 damage for each Psychic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 造成自己场上所有宝可梦身上附加的【超】能量数量×50点伤害。

me1-183.text: You can use this card only if your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining.  Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to that Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon ex. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me1-183.textz: 只有在对手剩余的奖赏卡为2张以下时，才可以使用这张卡。选择自己场上的1只宝可梦。在下个对手的回合，那只宝可梦不会受到对手宝可梦ex招式的伤害与效果影响。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me1-184.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me1-184.textz: 将自己的手牌全部放回牌库并重洗。然后，从牌库抽出6张卡。若自己剩余的奖赏卡正好为6张，则改为抽出8张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

me1-185.text: Ask your opponent if each player may take a Prize card. If yes, each player takes a Prize card. If no, you draw 4 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
me1-185.textz: 询问对手是否双方各拿取1张奖赏卡。若对手同意，则双方各拿取1张奖赏卡。若对手不同意，则自己从牌库抽出4张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

abilities.tz: 只要这只宝可梦在备战区，就不会受到对手宝可梦招式的伤害。

rsv10pt5-79.text: Play this card as if it were a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. This card can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat.  At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
rsv10pt5-79.textz: 这张卡视为HP60的【无色】基础宝可梦使用。这张卡不会陷入特殊状态，也无法撤退。在自己的回合中随时可以将场上的这张卡丢弃。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

rsv10pt5-80.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to doesn't have a Rule Box, the attacks it uses do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.) You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
rsv10pt5-80.textz: 若附有这张卡的宝可梦没有规则框，则它的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦ex造成的伤害增加30点（计算弱点和抗性前）。（宝可梦ex、宝可梦V等拥有规则框。）在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。将1张宝可梦道具附于自己身上没有附加宝可梦道具的1只宝可梦身上。

rsv10pt5-81.text: Draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
rsv10pt5-81.textz: 从牌库抽出3张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

rsv10pt5-82.text: Put up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
rsv10pt5-82.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择最多2张基本能量卡，加入手牌。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

rsv10pt5-83.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, flip a coin. If heads, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. If tails, you draw 3 cards, and your opponent draws 5 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
rsv10pt5-83.textz: 双方玩家各自将手牌放回牌库并重洗。然后，掷1次硬币。若为正面，则自己抽出5张卡，对手抽出3张卡。若为反面，则自己抽出3张卡，对手抽出5张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

rsv10pt5-84.text: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
rsv10pt5-84.textz: 从自己的牌库选择进化宝可梦和能量卡各1张，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

rsv10pt5-85.text: Choose up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to Pokémon (yours or your opponent's) and discard them. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
rsv10pt5-85.textz: 选择最多2张附于宝可梦（不论敌我）身上的宝可梦道具，将其丢弃。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

rsv10pt5-86.text: If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn.  As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.  If this card is attached to an Evolution Pokémon, it provides ColorlessColorlessColorless Energy instead.
rsv10pt5-86.textz: 若这张卡附于自己的宝可梦身上，则在自己的回合结束时将它丢弃。只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为1个【无色】能量。若这张卡附于进化宝可梦身上，则改为视为3个【无色】能量。
