attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【中毒】。因这个【中毒】而放置的伤害指示物的数量改为8个。

sv10-119.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-119.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【中毒】。

abilities.t: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌使出这张卡并完成进化时，可使用1次。在对手的1只宝可梦身上放置2个伤害指示物。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【混乱】。

abilities.t: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 2 damage counters on each of them.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌使出这张卡并完成进化时，可使用1次。在对手的2只宝可梦身上各放置2个伤害指示物。

attacks.t: You may put this Pokémon into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to this Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 若希望，将这只宝可梦放回手牌。（宝可梦以外的卡全部丢弃。）

sv10-122.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-122.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard the Defending Pokémon and all attached cards.
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合结束时，将受到这个招式的宝可梦与附加的卡全部丢弃。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【混乱】。在下个对手的回合，受到这个招式的宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.t: This attack does 100 damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 造成对手的战斗宝可梦处于特殊状态的数量×100点伤害。

abilities.t: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon that have "Koffing" in their name and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.tz: 这只宝可梦在战斗场受到对手的宝可梦招式的伤害时，从自己的牌库选择最多2张名称中有「瓦斯弹」的宝可梦卡，放置于备战区。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: This attack does 40 damage for each Pokémon in play that has "Koffing" or "Weezing" in its name (both yours and your opponent's).
attacks.tz: 造成双方的场上的，名称中有「瓦斯弹」或者「双弹瓦斯」的宝可梦的数量×40点伤害。

attacks.t: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择1张支持者卡，在给对手看过后加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.
attacks.tz: 选择1个对手的战斗宝可梦持有的招式。在下个对手的回合，受到这个招式的宝可梦无法使用被选择的招式。

attacks.t: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 对手的1只备战宝可梦，受到那只宝可梦身上放置的伤害指示物的数量×20点伤害。[在备战区不计算弱点・抵抗力。]

attacks.t: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Cynthia's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.
attacks.tz: 造成自己的备战区的所有「竹兰的宝可梦」身上放置的伤害指示物的数量×10点伤害。这个招式的伤害不计算弱点。

attacks.t: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 40 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若对手的战斗宝可梦为宝可梦ex，则增加40点伤害。

attacks.t: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 70 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若对手的战斗宝可梦为宝可梦ex，则增加70点伤害。

attacks.t: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择1个对手的战斗宝可梦身上附加的能量，将其丢弃。

attacks.t: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
attacks.tz: 这只宝可梦也受到30点伤害。

attacks.t: Draw a card.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库抽出1张卡。

abilities.t: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 5 Basic Darkness Energy cards and attach them to your Marnie's Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌使出这张卡并完成进化时，可以从自己的牌库选择最多5张「基本【恶】能量」卡，以任意方式附于自己「玛俐的」宝可梦身上。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 对手的1只备战宝可梦也受到30点伤害。[在备战区不计算弱点・抵抗力。]

sv10-136.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-136.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: This attack does 40 more damage for each Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 这只宝可梦身上每附加1个【恶】能量，就增加40点伤害。

attacks.t: If this Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 120 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若这只宝可梦身上没有放置伤害指示物，则增加120点伤害。

attacks.t: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Boss Headbutt.
attacks.tz: 在下个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法使用「大佬头击」。

sv10-139.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-139.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: You may move any amount of Metal Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.tz: 选择自己的场上宝可梦身上附加的任意数量的【钢】能量卡，以任意方式改附于自己的宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.
attacks.tz: 掷4次硬币，造成正面出现的次数×80点伤害。

attacks.t: Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can't retreat.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦恢复「50」HP。在下个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法撤退。

attacks.t: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 对手的2只宝可梦各受到50点伤害。[在备战区不计算弱点・抵抗力。]

attacks.t: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
attacks.tz: 在下个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法使用招式。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Basic Psychic Energy card, a Basic Metal Energy card, or 1 of each and attach them to your Psychic Pokémon and Metal Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合可使用1次：从自己的牌库选择「基本【超】能量」卡、「基本【钢】能量」卡或各1张，以任意方式附于自己的【超】宝可梦和【钢】宝可梦身上。并且重洗牌库。

sv10-145.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-145.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon equal to the damage done to this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害时，将与受到的伤害相同数值的伤害指示物，放置于使用招式的宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【中毒】。

attacks.t: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.
attacks.tz: 掷2次硬币，若全部为反面，则这只宝可梦也受到90点伤害。

attacks.t: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.
attacks.tz: 在不看正面的情况下，从对手的手牌选择1张，查看那张卡的正面后放回对手的牌库并重洗。

attacks.t: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
attacks.tz: 掷3次硬币，造成正面出现的次数×20点伤害。

attacks.t: Reveal the top 10 cards of your opponent's deck. You may choose an attack from a Pokémon you find there and use it as this attack. Shuffle the revealed cards into your opponent's deck.
attacks.tz: 将对手的牌库上方10张卡翻到正面。若希望，选择1个其中的宝可梦持有的招式，作为这个招式使用。将翻到正面的卡放回牌库并重洗。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【混乱】。

sv10-150.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-150.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.
attacks.tz: 掷2次硬币，造成正面出现的次数×90点伤害。

attacks.t: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若对手的战斗宝可梦为进化宝可梦，则增加50点伤害。

attacks.t: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, your opponent discards a card from their hand.
attacks.tz: 选择1张自己的手牌，将其丢弃。然后，对手选择1张对手自己的手牌，将其丢弃。

attacks.t: This attack does 20 damage for each Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name in your discard pile.
attacks.tz: 造成自己弃牌区名字带有「火箭队」的支持者卡张数×20点伤害。

abilities.t: You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw a card.
abilities.tz: 必须将2张手牌丢弃，才可以使用这个特性。在自己的回合可使用1次：从牌库抽出1张卡。

attacks.t: This attack does 20 damage for each Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name in your discard pile.
attacks.tz: 造成自己弃牌区名字带有「火箭队」的支持者卡张数×20点伤害。

attacks.t: Draw 3 cards.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库抽出3张卡。

attacks.t: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 在造成伤害前，将对手的战斗宝可梦身上附加的「宝可梦道具」卡丢弃。

abilities.t: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put up to 2 Arven's Sandwich cards from your discard pile into your hand.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌使出这张卡并完成进化时，可使用1次。从自己的弃牌区选择最多2张「派帕的三明治」，在给对手看过后加入手牌。

attacks.t: You may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 若希望，将对手的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。[由对手选择放置于战斗场的宝可梦。]

sv10-161.text: Heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon. If that Pokémon is an Arven's Pokémon, heal 100 damage from it instead. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv10-161.textz: 将自己的战斗宝可梦恢复「30」HP。若那只宝可梦是「派帕的」宝可梦，则改为恢复「100」HP。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv10-162.text: The Cynthia's Pokémon this card is attached to gets +70 HP. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
sv10-162.textz: 附有这张卡的「竹兰的」宝可梦最大HP增加「70」。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

sv10-163.text: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 2 more cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-163.textz: 从牌库抽出2张卡。若对手剩余的奖赏卡为3张以下，则再多抽2张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-164.text: Shuffle up to 5 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv10-164.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择最多5张基本能量卡，放回牌库并重洗。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv10-165.text: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Ethan's Pokémon and Basic Fire Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-165.textz: 从自己的牌库选择「阿响的」宝可梦和「基本【火】能量」卡合计最多3张，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-166.text: Steven's Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) take 30 less damage from attacks from the opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv10-166.textz: 「大吾的」宝可梦（不论敌我）受到对方宝可梦招式的伤害减少30点（计算弱点和抗性后）。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv10-167.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-167.textz: 双方玩家各自将手牌放回牌库并重洗，然后各抽出4张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-168.text: Shuffle up to 5 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv10-168.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择最多5张宝可梦，放回牌库并重洗。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv10-169.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Marnie's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv10-169.textz: 在各自的回合，双方玩家都可以各1次：从牌库选择1张「玛俐的」宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。然后，那位玩家重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv10-170.text: You can use this card only if any of your Team Rocket's Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.  Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-170.textz: 只有在上一个对手的回合，自己的火箭队的宝可梦【昏厥】过，才可以使用这张卡。双方玩家各自将手牌放回牌库并重洗。然后，自己抽出5张卡，对手抽出3张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-171.text: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If all of your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket's Pokémon, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-171.textz: 从牌库抽卡，直到自己的手牌变成5张为止。若自己场上的宝可梦全部都是火箭队的宝可梦，则改为抽卡直到手牌变成8张为止。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-172.text: Turn 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards face up and choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card. You may have your opponent switch those cards. (That Prize card remains face up for the rest of the game.) You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv10-172.textz: 将对手的1张反面朝上的奖赏卡翻成正面，并随机选择对手的1张手牌。对手公开那张卡。可以让对手将那2张卡互换。（那张奖赏卡在对战结束前一直保持正面朝上。）在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv10-173.text: Once during each player's turn, if they played a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name from their hand this turn, they may draw 2 cards. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv10-173.textz: 在各自的回合，若那位玩家在这个回合从手牌使出了名字带有「火箭队」的支持者卡，则可以各1次从牌库抽出2张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv10-174.text: Switch your Active Team Rocket's Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Team Rocket's Pokémon. If you do, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-174.textz: 将自己的火箭队的战斗宝可梦与火箭队的备战宝可梦互换。若这么做，则选择1只对手的备战宝可梦，与战斗宝可梦互换。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-175.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv10-175.textz: 掷1次硬币。若为正面，则从自己的牌库选择1张火箭队的进化宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。若为反面，则从自己的牌库选择1张火箭队的基础宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv10-176.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-176.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张训练家卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-177.text: If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.  Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-177.textz: 若自己是先攻，在最初的回合也可以使用这张卡。从自己的牌库选择最多3张火箭队的基础宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-178.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv10-178.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张名字带有「火箭队」的支持者卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv10-179.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, put 2 damage counters on your Active Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv10-179.textz: 掷1次硬币。若为正面，则在对手的1只宝可梦身上放置2个伤害指示物。若为反面，则在自己的战斗宝可梦身上放置2个伤害指示物。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv10-180.text: Colorless Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv10-180.textz: 场上的【无色】宝可梦（不论敌我）的特性全部消除。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv10-181.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon Tool cards that have "Technical Machine" in their name, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv10-181.textz: 从自己的牌库选择最多3张名字带有「招式学习器」的宝可梦道具卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv10-182.text: This card can only be attached to a Team Rocket's Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Rocket's Pokémon, discard this card.  As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides 2 in any combination of Psychic Energy and Darkness Energy.
sv10-182.textz: 这张卡只能附于火箭队的宝可梦身上。若这张卡附于火箭队的宝可梦以外的宝可梦身上，则将这张卡丢弃。只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为【超】能量和【恶】能量任意组合的2个能量。

attacks.t: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。[由对手选择放置于战斗场的宝可梦。]

abilities.t: Attacks used by your Cynthia's Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.tz: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，自己的「竹兰的宝可梦」使用的招式，对对手的战斗宝可梦造成的伤害「+30」点。

abilities.t: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon that don't have a Rule Box by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
abilities.tz: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，自己的所有备战宝可梦（「拥有规则的宝可梦」除外）不会受到对手的招式的伤害。

abilities.t: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon ex.
abilities.tz: 这只宝可梦不会受到对手的「宝可梦【ex】」招式的伤害。

attacks.t: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 这个招式的伤害不计算对手的战斗宝可梦身上的附加效果。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合时可使用1次。从自己的弃牌区选择1张基本能量卡，附于这只宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Team Rocket's Pokémon in play.
attacks.tz: 造成自己的场上「火箭队的宝可梦」的数量×30点伤害。

attacks.t: Discard 6 Basic Grass Energy cards from your hand, and Knock Out your opponent's Active Pokémon. If you can't discard 6 cards in this way, this attack does nothing.
attacks.tz: 从自己的手牌将6张「基本【草】能量」卡丢弃，将对手的战斗宝可梦【昏厥】。若无法丢弃6张，则这个招式失败。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, you may draw a card.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合时可使用1次。从自己的牌库抽出1张卡。

attacks.t: This attack does 60 more damage for each Ethan's Adventure card in your discard pile.
attacks.tz: 自己弃牌区每有1张「阿响的冒险」，就增加60点伤害。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【灼伤】与【混乱】。

attacks.t: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择1个这只宝可梦身上附加的能量，将其丢弃。

attacks.t: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 将2个这只宝可梦身上附加的能量丢弃，对手的1只备战宝可梦也受到120点伤害。[在备战区不计算弱点・抵抗力。]

abilities.t: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may discard the bottom card of your deck. If you do, discard all cards from this Pokémon and put this Pokémon on top of your deck.
abilities.tz: 若这只宝可梦在备战区，则在自己的回合时可使用1次。将自己的牌库下方1张卡丢弃。然后，将这只宝可梦身上附加的卡全部丢弃，将这只宝可梦放回牌库上方。

attacks.t: Search your deck for up to 3 Misty's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择最多3张「小霞的宝可梦」，在给对手看过后加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害「-10」点。

attacks.t: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.
attacks.tz: 在不看正面的情况下，从对手的手牌选择1张，查看那张卡的正面后放回对手的牌库并重洗。

attacks.t: This attack does 30 damage for each Pokémon Tool attached to all of your Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 造成自己的所有宝可梦身上附加的「宝可梦道具」卡的数量×30点伤害。

abilities.t: As often as you like during your turn, you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Team Rocket's Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合时，可不限次数使用。选择1个自己的场上的「火箭队的宝可梦」身上放置的伤害指示物，改放于自己的其他宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 增加对手的战斗宝可梦身上附加的能量的数量×40点伤害。

attacks.t: This attack does 40 damage for each Pokémon in play that has "Koffing" or "Weezing" in its name (both yours and your opponent's).
attacks.tz: 造成双方的场上的，名称中有「瓦斯弹」或者「双弹瓦斯」的宝可梦的数量×40点伤害。

attacks.t: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择1张支持者卡，在给对手看过后加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.
attacks.tz: 选择1个对手的战斗宝可梦持有的招式。在下个对手的回合，受到这个招式的宝可梦无法使用被选择的招式。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon equal to the damage done to this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害时，将与受到的伤害相同数值的伤害指示物，放置于使用招式的宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are tails, this Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.
attacks.tz: 掷2次硬币，若全部为反面，则这只宝可梦也受到90点伤害。

attacks.t: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.
attacks.tz: 在不看正面的情况下，从对手的手牌选择1张，查看那张卡的正面后放回对手的牌库并重洗。

attacks.t: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
attacks.tz: 掷3次硬币，造成正面出现的次数×20点伤害。

attacks.t: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.
attacks.tz: 掷2次硬币，造成正面出现的次数×90点伤害。

abilities.t: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put up to 2 Arven's Sandwich cards from your discard pile into your hand.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌使出这张卡并完成进化时，可使用1次。从自己的弃牌区选择最多2张「派帕的三明治」，在给对手看过后加入手牌。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic Grass Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从备战区将这只宝可梦放置于战斗场时，可使用1次。从自己的牌库选择最多3张「基本【草】能量」卡，附于这只宝可梦身上。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Move 3 Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择3个这只宝可梦身上附加的能量，改附于1只备战宝可梦身上。

sv10-206.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-206.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon 6 times. (You can choose the same Pokémon more than once.) For each time you chose a Pokémon, do 20 damage to it. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.
attacks.tz: 选择6次对手的宝可梦，对所选的所有宝可梦不计算弱点・抵抗力，造成其选择次数×20点伤害。（1只可选择2次以上。）

attacks.t: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦的特殊状态全部恢复。

sv10-207.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-207.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害「-50」点。

attacks.t: Discard a Team Rocket's Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard your opponent's Active Pokémon and all attached cards.
attacks.tz: 选择1张这只宝可梦身上附加的「火箭队能量」，将其丢弃。这个情况下，将对手的战斗宝可梦与附加的卡全部丢弃。

sv10-208.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-208.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Basic Fire Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Benched Ethan's Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合时可使用1次。从自己的手牌选择最多2张「基本【火】能量」卡，附于备战区的1只「阿响的宝可梦」身上。

attacks.t: Heal 50 damage from each of your Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将自己的所有宝可梦各恢复「50」HP。

sv10-209.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-209.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: Whenever your opponent plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 对手从手牌使出物品卡或者支持者卡时，这只宝可梦不会受到那个效果的影响。

attacks.t: You may discard a Stadium in play. If you do, this attack does 140 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若希望，将场上的竞技场卡丢弃。这个情况下，增加140点伤害。

sv10-210.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-210.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 增加这只宝可梦身上放置的伤害指示物的数量×10点伤害。

attacks.t: You may do 120 more damage. If you do, this Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.
attacks.tz: 若希望，增加120点伤害。这个情况下，这只宝可梦也受到50点伤害。

sv10-211.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-211.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 对手的2只宝可梦各受到50点伤害。[在备战区不计算弱点・抵抗力。]

attacks.t: If this Pokémon has at least 2 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 100 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若身上附有的能量比使用这个招式所需的能量多2个，则增加100点伤害。

sv10-212.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-212.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: This Pokémon can't attack unless you have 4 or more Team Rocket's Pokémon in play.
abilities.tz: 只有在自己的场上的「火箭队的宝可梦」数量为4只以上时，这只宝可梦才可使用招式。

attacks.t: You may discard up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 60 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.
attacks.tz: 若希望，将最多2张自己的备战宝可梦身上附加的能量卡丢弃，增加其张数×60点伤害。

sv10-213.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-213.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Attach up to 2 Basic Fighting Energy cards from your discard pile to this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 从自己的弃牌区选择最多2张「基本【斗】能量」卡，附于这只宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Stage 2 Pokémon, this attack does 140 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若对手的战斗宝可梦为【2阶进化】宝可梦，则增加140点伤害。

sv10-214.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-214.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
attacks.tz: 若希望，从牌库抽卡直到自己的手牌满6张为止。

attacks.t: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上附加的能量卡全部丢弃。

sv10-215.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-215.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, put 8 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【中毒】。因这个【中毒】而放置的伤害指示物的数量改为8个。

sv10-216.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-216.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 2 damage counters on each of them.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌使出这张卡并完成进化时，可使用1次。在对手的2只宝可梦身上各放置2个伤害指示物。

attacks.t: You may put this Pokémon into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to this Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 若希望，将这只宝可梦放回手牌。（宝可梦以外的卡全部丢弃。）

sv10-217.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-217.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: If this Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 120 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若这只宝可梦身上没有放置伤害指示物，则增加120点伤害。

attacks.t: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Boss Headbutt.
attacks.tz: 在下个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法使用「大佬头击」。

sv10-218.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-218.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Reveal the top 10 cards of your opponent's deck. You may choose an attack from a Pokémon you find there and use it as this attack. Shuffle the revealed cards into your opponent's deck.
attacks.tz: 将对手的牌库上方10张卡翻到正面。若希望，选择1个其中的宝可梦持有的招式，作为这个招式使用。将翻到正面的卡放回牌库并重洗。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【混乱】。

sv10-219.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-219.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

sv10-220.text: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 2 more cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-220.textz: 从牌库抽出2张卡。若对手剩余的奖赏卡为3张以下，则再多抽2张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-221.text: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Ethan's Pokémon and Basic Fire Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-221.textz: 从自己的牌库选择「阿响的」宝可梦和「基本【火】能量」卡合计最多3张，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-222.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-222.textz: 双方玩家各自将手牌放回牌库并重洗，然后各抽出4张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-223.text: You can use this card only if any of your Team Rocket's Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.  Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-223.textz: 只有在上一个对手的回合，自己的火箭队的宝可梦【昏厥】过，才可以使用这张卡。双方玩家各自将手牌放回牌库并重洗。然后，自己抽出5张卡，对手抽出3张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-224.text: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If all of your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket's Pokémon, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-224.textz: 从牌库抽卡，直到自己的手牌变成5张为止。若自己场上的宝可梦全部都是火箭队的宝可梦，则改为抽卡直到手牌变成8张为止。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-225.text: Switch your Active Team Rocket's Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Team Rocket's Pokémon. If you do, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-225.textz: 将自己的火箭队的战斗宝可梦与火箭队的备战宝可梦互换。若这么做，则选择1只对手的备战宝可梦，与战斗宝可梦互换。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-226.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-226.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张训练家卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv10-227.text: If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.  Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv10-227.textz: 若自己是先攻，在最初的回合也可以使用这张卡。从自己的牌库选择最多3张火箭队的基础宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic Grass Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从备战区将这只宝可梦放置于战斗场时，可使用1次。从自己的牌库选择最多3张「基本【草】能量」卡，附于这只宝可梦身上。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: Move 3 Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择3个这只宝可梦身上附加的能量，改附于1只备战宝可梦身上。

sv10-228.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv10-228.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

sv8pt5-93.textz: 从牌库抽出4张卡。在这个回合结束时，若自己的手牌在5张以上，则将手牌全部丢弃。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-94.text: Each player who has any Tera Pokémon in play can have up to 8 Pokémon on their Bench.  If a player no longer has any Tera Pokémon in play, that player discards Pokémon from their Bench until they have 5. When this card leaves play, both players discard Pokémon from their Bench until they have 5, and the player who played this card discards first. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv8pt5-94.textz: 场上有太晶宝可梦的玩家，备战区最多可以放置8只宝可梦。若玩家场上不再有太晶宝可梦，则那位玩家将备战宝可梦丢弃，直到剩下5只为止。这张卡离场时，双方玩家将备战宝可梦丢弃，直到剩下5只为止，由使出这张卡的玩家先进行。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv8pt5-95.text: Attacks used by the Poisoned Pokémon this card is attached to do 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
sv8pt5-95.textz: 附有这张卡的【中毒】宝可梦使用的招式对对手战斗宝可梦造成的伤害增加40点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

sv8pt5-96.text: During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-96.textz: 在这个回合，自己的宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦ex造成的伤害增加40点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-97.text: During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-97.textz: 在这个回合，自己的宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦ex造成的伤害增加40点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-98.text: During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-98.textz: 在这个回合，自己的宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦ex造成的伤害增加40点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-99.text: During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-99.textz: 在这个回合，自己的宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦ex造成的伤害增加40点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-100.text: You can use this card only if your opponent has exactly 2 Prize cards remaining.    During this turn, if your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack used by your Tera Pokémon, take 1 more Prize card. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-100.textz: 只有在对手剩余的奖赏卡正好为2张时，才可以使用这张卡。在这个回合，若对手的战斗宝可梦因自己太晶宝可梦使用招式的伤害而【昏厥】，则多拿取1张奖赏卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-101.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-101.textz: 从自己的牌库选择最多2张HP70以下的基础宝可梦，放置于备战区。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-102.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal up to 2 in any combination of Grass Pokémon and Basic Grass Energy cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-102.textz: 查看自己牌库上方7张卡。可以从其中选择【草】宝可梦和「基本【草】能量」卡合计最多2张，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。将剩余的卡放回牌库并重洗。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-103.text: If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.  Discard your hand and draw 5 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-103.textz: 若自己是先攻，在最初的回合也可以使用这张卡。将自己的手牌全部丢弃，然后从牌库抽出5张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-104.text: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, then put those cards on top of it in any order. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-104.textz: 从自己的牌库选择2张卡，将牌库重洗后，以任意顺序放回牌库上方。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-105.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put 1 of them into your hand. Attach the other to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-105.textz: 从自己的牌库选择最多2张不同属性的基本能量卡，在给对手看过之后，将其中1张加入手牌。将另1张附于自己的1只宝可梦身上。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-106.text: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.  Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-106.textz: 必须将自己的另外1张手牌丢弃，才可以使用这张卡。从自己的牌库选择最多2张基本能量卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-107.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-107.textz: 查看自己牌库上方6张卡，从其中选择2张加入手牌。将剩余的卡丢弃。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-108.text: Each Pokémon that has any Energy attached (both yours and your opponent's) recovers from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv8pt5-108.textz: 身上附有能量的所有宝可梦（不论敌我）从所有特殊状态中恢复，且不会陷入特殊状态。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv8pt5-109.text: Draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-109.textz: 从牌库抽出3张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-110.text: You can use this card only if you have any Tera Pokémon in play.  Choose up to 2 of your Benched Colorless Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-110.textz: 只有在自己场上有太晶宝可梦时，才可以使用这张卡。选择自己最多2只【无色】备战宝可梦，从弃牌区各选择1张基本能量卡附于其身上。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-111.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Dragon Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
sv8pt5-111.textz: 若附有这张卡的宝可梦受到对手【龙】宝可梦招式的伤害，则伤害减少60点（计算弱点和抗性后），并将这张卡丢弃。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

sv8pt5-112.text: Choose up to 2 of your Darkness Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic Darkness Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to your Active Pokémon in this way, it is now Poisoned. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-112.textz: 选择自己最多2只【恶】宝可梦。从自己的牌库各选择1张「基本【恶】能量」卡，附于那些宝可梦身上。并且重洗牌库。若以这种方式将能量附于自己的战斗宝可梦身上，则令它【中毒】。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-113.text: Choose 1:    • Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.  • During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex and Active Pokémon V (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-113.textz: 选择1项：• 将自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。• 在这个回合，自己的宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦ex和战斗宝可梦V造成的伤害增加30点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-114.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-114.textz: 将自己的手牌全部放回牌库并重洗。然后，从牌库抽出4张卡。若对手剩余的奖赏卡为3张以下，则改为抽出8张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-115.text: Discard your hand and search your deck for a Pokémon, a Supporter card, and a Basic Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-115.textz: 将自己的手牌全部丢弃，从牌库选择宝可梦、支持者卡和基本能量卡各1张，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-116.text: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck. Put up to 5 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-116.textz: 卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。从自己的弃牌区选择宝可梦和基本能量卡合计最多5张，加入手牌。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-117.text: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck. Attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to do 50 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
sv8pt5-117.textz: 卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。附有这张卡的宝可梦使用的招式对对手的战斗宝可梦ex造成的伤害增加50点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

sv8pt5-118.text: Choose a Pokémon ex in your discard pile that has "Ogerpon" in its name, and switch it with 1 of your Pokémon ex in play that has "Ogerpon" in its name. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-118.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择1张名字带有「厄鬼椪」的宝可梦ex，与自己场上1只名字带有「厄鬼椪」的宝可梦ex交换。附加的卡、伤害指示物、特殊状态、登场的回合数以及其他效果，全部由新的宝可梦继承。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-119.text: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck. Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-119.textz: 卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。选择1只对手的备战宝可梦，与战斗宝可梦互换。若这么做，则将自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-120.text: Choose up to 2 of your Ancient Pokémon and attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. If you attached any Energy in this way, draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-120.textz: 选择自己最多2只古代宝可梦，从弃牌区各选择1张基本能量卡附于其身上。若以这种方式附加了能量，则从牌库抽出3张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-121.text: Put 1 of your Pokémon in play into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-121.textz: 将自己场上的1只宝可梦加入手牌。（将那只宝可梦身上附加的卡全部丢弃。）在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-122.text: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-122.textz: 将自己的手牌全部丢弃，然后从牌库抽出7张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-123.text: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-123.textz: 将自己的手牌全部丢弃，然后从牌库抽出7张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-124.text: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-124.textz: 将自己的手牌全部丢弃，然后从牌库抽出7张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-125.text: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-125.textz: 将自己的手牌全部丢弃，然后从牌库抽出7张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-126.text: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is Colorless less. If that Pokémon's remaining HP is 30 or less, it has no Retreat Cost. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
sv8pt5-126.textz: 附有这张卡的宝可梦，撤退所需能量减少1个【无色】。若那只宝可梦的剩余HP在30以下，则撤退时不需要能量。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

sv8pt5-127.text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Supporter cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-127.textz: 查看自己牌库上方4张卡。可以从其中选择任意张支持者卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。将剩余的卡放回牌库并重洗。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-128.text: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck. Put 1 of your Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-128.textz: 卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。将自己的1只宝可梦及其身上附加的所有卡加入手牌。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-129.text: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck. When the Tera Pokémon this card is attached to uses an attack, that attack costs 1 Energy less. (The Energy can be of any type.) You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.
sv8pt5-129.textz: 卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。附有这张卡的太晶宝可梦使用招式时，所需能量减少1个。（可以是任意属性的能量。）在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。

sv8pt5-130.text: You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.  Search your deck for up to 2 Future Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-130.textz: 必须将自己的另外1张手牌丢弃，才可以使用这张卡。从自己的牌库选择最多2张未来宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-131.text: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck. Search your deck for up to 5 Pokémon Tool cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8pt5-131.textz: 卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。从自己的牌库选择最多5张宝可梦道具卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8pt5-132.text: Draw 4 cards. At the end of this turn, if you have 5 or more cards in your hand, discard your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-132.textz: 从牌库抽出4张卡。在这个回合结束时，若自己的手牌在5张以上，则将手牌全部丢弃。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-133.text: You can use this card only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned.  Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-133.textz: 只有在对手的战斗宝可梦处于【中毒】状态时，才可以使用这张卡。将自己的手牌全部放回牌库并重洗。然后，从牌库抽出7张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-134.text: You can use this card only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned.  Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-134.textz: 只有在对手的战斗宝可梦处于【中毒】状态时，才可以使用这张卡。将自己的手牌全部放回牌库并重洗。然后，从牌库抽出7张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-135.text: Count the cards in your hand, shuffle those cards into your deck, then draw that many cards plus 1. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-135.textz: 数一数自己的手牌张数，将那些卡放回牌库并重洗，然后抽出相同张数再加1张的卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-136.text: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you discard up to 2 Item cards you find there. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-136.textz: 对手公开手牌，从其中选择最多2张物品卡丢弃。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-137.text: Draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-137.textz: 从牌库抽出3张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-138.text: Discard a Special Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-138.textz: 将对手每只宝可梦身上的1个特殊能量丢弃。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-139.text: Discard your hand and search your deck for a Pokémon, a Supporter card, and a Basic Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8pt5-139.textz: 将自己的手牌全部丢弃，从牌库选择宝可梦、支持者卡和基本能量卡各1张，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8pt5-140.text: You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.  Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

sv9-152.textz: 场上「N的」宝可梦（不论敌我）撤退时不需要能量。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv9-153.text: Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched N's Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv9-153.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择1张基本能量卡，附于自己的1只「N的」备战宝可梦身上。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv9-154.text: Attacks used by Hop's Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) do 30 more damage to the opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv9-154.textz: 「赫普的」宝可梦（不论敌我）使用的招式对对方战斗宝可梦造成的伤害增加30点（计算弱点和抗性前）。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场旁边，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv9-155.text: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv9-155.textz: 将自己的手牌全部丢弃，然后从牌库抽出7张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv9-156.text: Count your Prize cards, shuffle them, and put them on the bottom of your deck. Then, take that many cards from the top of your deck and put them face down as your Prize cards. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv9-156.textz: 数一数自己的奖赏卡张数，重洗后放回牌库下方。然后，从牌库上方拿取相同张数的卡，反面朝上作为奖赏卡。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8-162.textz: 若附有这张卡的宝可梦因对手宝可梦招式的伤害而【昏厥】，则从自己的牌库选择最多3张卡，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。将1张宝可梦道具附于自己身上没有附加宝可梦道具的1只宝可梦身上。ACE SPEC：卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。

sv8-163.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Metal Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
sv8-163.textz: 若附有这张卡的宝可梦受到对手【钢】宝可梦招式的伤害，则伤害减少60点（计算弱点和抗性后），并将这张卡丢弃。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。将1张宝可梦道具附于自己身上没有附加宝可梦道具的1只宝可梦身上。

sv8-164.text: Search your deck for up to 5 cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. ACE SPEC: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.
sv8-164.textz: 从自己的牌库选择最多5张卡丢弃。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。ACE SPEC：卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。

sv8-165.text: You can use this card only if you go second, and only during your first turn.  Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8-165.textz: 只有在自己是后攻且在自己最初的回合，才可以使用这张卡。从自己的牌库选择1张支持者卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8-166.text: You can use this card only if you go second, and only during your first turn.  Put an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon into their hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8-166.textz: 只有在自己是后攻且在自己最初的回合，才可以使用这张卡。将对手1只宝可梦身上附加的1个能量放回对手的手牌。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8-167.text: Heal 60 damage from each of your Lightning Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8-167.textz: 将自己的每只【雷】宝可梦各恢复「60」HP。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8-168.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Darkness Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
sv8-168.textz: 若附有这张卡的宝可梦受到对手【恶】宝可梦招式的伤害，则伤害减少60点（计算弱点和抗性后），并将这张卡丢弃。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。将1张宝可梦道具附于自己身上没有附加宝可梦道具的1只宝可梦身上。

sv8-169.text: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, attacks used by the Pokémon this card is attached to cost Colorless less. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
sv8-169.textz: 若自己剩余的奖赏卡比对手多，则附有这张卡的宝可梦使用招式所需能量减少1个【无色】。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。将1张宝可梦道具附于自己身上没有附加宝可梦道具的1只宝可梦身上。

sv8-170.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon ex, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8-170.textz: 从自己的牌库选择最多3张宝可梦ex，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8-171.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order, or shuffle them and put them on the bottom of your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8-171.textz: 查看自己牌库上方3张卡，以任意顺序放回；或将它们重洗后放回牌库下方。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8-172.text: Heal 60 damage from your Active Dragon Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8-172.textz: 将自己的【龙】战斗宝可梦恢复「60」HP。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8-173.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, flip a coin. If heads, draw 8 cards. If tails, draw 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8-173.textz: 将自己的手牌全部放回牌库并重洗。然后，掷1次硬币。若为正面，则从牌库抽出8张卡。若为反面，则从牌库抽出3张卡。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8-174.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon and a Trainer card you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8-174.textz: 查看自己牌库上方7张卡。可以从其中选择1张宝可梦和1张训练家卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。将剩余的卡放回牌库并重洗。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8-175.text: Look at the bottom 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8-175.textz: 查看自己牌库下方7张卡。可以从其中选择1张宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。将剩余的卡放回牌库并重洗。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8-176.text: Search your deck for any number of Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. ACE SPEC: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.
sv8-176.textz: 从自己的牌库选择任意张不同属性的基本能量卡，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。ACE SPEC：卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。

sv8-177.text: Each Stage 2 Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets -30 HP. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it into the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv8-177.textz: 场上所有2阶进化宝可梦（不论敌我）的最大HP减少「30」。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv8-178.text: During your opponent's next turn, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (This includes new Pokémon that come into play.) You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8-178.textz: 在下个对手的回合，自己所有宝可梦受到对手宝可梦招式的伤害减少30点（计算弱点和抗性后）。（包括之后登场的宝可梦。）在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8-179.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, the new Active Pokémon is now Confused. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8-179.textz: 选择1只对手的基础备战宝可梦，与战斗宝可梦互换。若这么做，则令新的战斗宝可梦【混乱】。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8-180.text: Each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets +30 HP. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it into the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv8-180.textz: 场上所有基础宝可梦（不论敌我）的最大HP增加「30」。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv8-181.text: Your opponent counts the cards in their hand, shuffles those cards, and puts them on the bottom of their deck. If they do, they draw that many cards. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8-181.textz: 对手数一数自己的手牌张数，将那些卡重洗后放回牌库下方。若这么做，则对手抽出相同张数的卡。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8-182.text: Discard all Pokémon Tools and Special Energy from all of your opponent's Pokémon, and discard a Stadium in play. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. ACE SPEC: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.
sv8-182.textz: 将对手所有宝可梦身上的宝可梦道具和特殊能量全部丢弃，并将场上的竞技场卡丢弃。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。ACE SPEC：卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。

sv8-183.text: Put up to 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. ACE SPEC: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.
sv8-183.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择最多2张支持者卡，加入手牌。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。ACE SPEC：卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。

sv8-184.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Water Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
sv8-184.textz: 若附有这张卡的宝可梦受到对手【水】宝可梦招式的伤害，则伤害减少60点（计算弱点和抗性后），并将这张卡丢弃。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。将1张宝可梦道具附于自己身上没有附加宝可梦道具的1只宝可梦身上。

sv8-185.text: Search your deck for any number of Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. ACE SPEC: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.
sv8-185.textz: 从自己的牌库选择任意数量的基础宝可梦，放置于备战区。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。ACE SPEC：卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。

sv8-186.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, you may move any amount of Energy from the Pokémon you moved to your Bench to the new Active Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. ACE SPEC: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.
sv8-186.textz: 将自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。若这么做，则可以将移到备战区的宝可梦身上任意数量的能量，转附于新的战斗宝可梦身上。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。ACE SPEC：卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。

sv8-187.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8-187.textz: 将自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。若这么做，则从牌库抽卡，直到自己的手牌变成5张为止。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

attacks.t: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and heal all damage from each of your Tera Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上的所有能量丢弃，并将自己所有太晶宝可梦的HP全部恢复。

sv8-188.text: The Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your turn. You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
sv8-188.textz: 附有这张卡的宝可梦可以使用这张卡上的招式。（仍需附加使用该招式所需的能量。）若这张卡附于自己的宝可梦身上，则在自己的回合结束时将它丢弃。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。将1张宝可梦道具附于自己身上没有附加宝可梦道具的1只宝可梦身上。

sv8-189.text: Search your deck for a Tera Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8-189.textz: 从自己的牌库选择1张太晶宝可梦，在给对手看过之后，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8-190.text: Tell your opponent the name of a Pokémon in your hand and put that Pokémon face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses that Pokémon's HP, and then you reveal it. If your opponent guessed right, they draw 4 cards. If they guessed wrong, you draw 4 cards. Then, return the Pokémon to your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
sv8-190.textz: 告诉对手自己手牌中1张宝可梦的名字，将那张宝可梦反面朝上放在自己面前。对手猜那只宝可梦的HP，然后公开那张卡。若对手猜对，则对手从牌库抽出4张卡。若对手猜错，则自己从牌库抽出4张卡。然后，将那张宝可梦放回手牌。在自己的回合只可以使用1张支持者卡。

sv8-191.text: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.  When you attach this card from your hand to a Pokémon, draw 4 cards. ACE SPEC: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.
sv8-191.textz: 只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为1个【无色】能量。从手牌将这张卡附于宝可梦身上时，从牌库抽出4张卡。ACE SPEC：卡组里只能放入1张ACE SPEC卡。

attacks.t: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 这个招式可在先攻玩家的最初回合使用。从自己的牌库选择1张从这只宝可梦进化而来的卡，放置于这只宝可梦身上完成进化。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: For each of your Benched Pokémon, search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库，选择自己的所有备战宝可梦进化而来的卡各1张，放置于各自身上完成进化。并且重洗牌库。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Asleep.
abilities.tz: 若这只宝可梦在战斗场上，则在自己的回合可使用1次：令对手的战斗宝可梦【睡眠】。

attacks.t: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.
attacks.tz: 掷硬币直到出现反面为止。每出现1次正面，就增加30点伤害。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【灼伤】。

attacks.t: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上的所有能量，转附于自己的1只备战宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: Discard all Special Energy from all of your opponent's Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将对手的所有宝可梦身上附加的特殊能量卡全部丢弃。

attacks.t: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
attacks.tz: 在下个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.t: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。

attacks.t: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.
attacks.tz: 将对手的战斗宝可梦【睡眠】。

abilities.t: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 这只宝可梦在战斗场受到对手的宝可梦招式的伤害时，在使用招式的宝可梦身上放置3个伤害指示物。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，受到这个招式的宝可梦无法撤退。

abilities.t: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.tz: 这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害「-30」点。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed, and discard an Energy from that Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币若为正面，则将对手的战斗宝可梦【麻痹】。再选择1个那只宝可梦身上附加的能量，将其丢弃。

attacks.t: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 对手的1只宝可梦受到50点伤害。[在备战区不计算弱点・抵抗力。]

attacks.t: Attach up to 2 Basic Psychic Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.tz: 从自己的手牌选择最多2张「基本【超】能量」卡，以任意方式附于自己的宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: If you don't have Uxie and Azelf on your Bench, this attack does nothing.
attacks.tz: 若自己的备战区没有「由克希」「亚克诺姆」，则这个招式失败。

attacks.t: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 50 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.tz: 在下个自己的回合，受到这个招式的宝可梦受到招式的伤害「+50」点。

attacks.t: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.tz: 这只宝可梦也受到10点伤害。

attacks.t: If you don't have exactly 3 cards in your hand, this attack does nothing.
attacks.tz: 若自己的手牌不是3张，则这个招式失败。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害「-30」点。

attacks.t: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 造成对手的战斗宝可梦身上放置的伤害指示物的数量×20点伤害。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，受到这个招式的宝可梦无法使用招式。

attacks.t: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
attacks.tz: 这只宝可梦也受到20点伤害。

attacks.t: Heal 60 damage from this Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can't retreat.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦恢复「60」HP。在下个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法撤退。

abilities.t: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.
abilities.tz: 这只宝可梦受到招式的伤害时，自己掷1次硬币。若为正面，则这只宝可梦不会受到那个伤害。

attacks.t: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 对手的1只宝可梦受到30点伤害。[在备战区不计算弱点・抵抗力。]

attacks.t: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 选择1只对手的备战宝可梦，与战斗宝可梦互换。然后，新上场的宝可梦受到40点伤害。

abilities.t: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard the top card of your opponent's deck.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌将这张卡放置于备战区时，可使用1次。将对手的牌库上方1张卡丢弃。

attacks.t: This attack does 30 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.
attacks.tz: 增加对手已经获得的奖赏卡的张数×30点伤害。

sv8-215.rule: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
sv8-215.rulez: 宝可梦ex规则：你的宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Grass and Fire type.
abilities.tz: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，改为【草】与【火】2种属性。

attacks.t: This attack does 70 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 增加这只宝可梦身上放置的伤害指示物的数量×70点伤害。

You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached. Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
sv8-249.textz: 若自己剩余的奖赏卡比对手多，则附有这张卡的宝可梦使用招式所需能量减少1个【无色】。在自己的回合可以将任意张宝可梦道具附于自己的宝可梦身上。每只宝可梦身上只可以附加1张宝可梦道具，附上后一直保留。将1张宝可梦道具附于自己身上没有附加宝可梦道具的1只宝可梦身上。

sv8-250.text: Each Stage 2 Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) gets -30 HP. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it into the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
sv8-250.textz: 场上所有2阶进化宝可梦（不论敌我）的最大HP减少「30」。在自己的回合只可以使用1张竞技场卡。放置在战斗场，若有其他竞技场卡登场则将这张卡丢弃。不能使用同名的竞技场卡。

sv8-251.text: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
sv8-251.textz: 从自己的弃牌区选择1张宝可梦或基本能量卡，加入手牌。在自己的回合可以使用任意张物品卡。

sv8-252.text: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy.  When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon, switch that Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.
sv8-252.textz: 只要这张卡附于宝可梦身上，就视为1个【无色】能量。从手牌将这张卡附于自己的备战宝可梦身上时，将那只宝可梦与战斗宝可梦互换。

attacks.t: Choose 2 Energy attached to Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND and put them in the Lost Zone. If any of your opponent's Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from this attack, put that Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone instead of discarding it.
attacks.tz: 选择达克莱伊&克雷色利亚LEGEND身上附加的2个能量，放入放逐区。若对手的宝可梦因这个招式的伤害而【昏厥】，则不将那只宝可梦及其身上附加的卡丢弃，改为放入放逐区。

attacks.t: Move as many damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon as you like to any of your opponent's other Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.tz: 将对手宝可梦身上任意数量的伤害指示物，以任意方式转放到对手的其他宝可梦身上。

me55-C19.rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND. When this Pokémon has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
me55-C19.rulez: 只能和达克莱伊&克雷色利亚LEGEND的另一半一起从手牌放到备战区。这只宝可梦昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Choose 2 Energy attached to Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND and put them in the Lost Zone. If any of your opponent's Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from this attack, put that Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone instead of discarding it.
attacks.tz: 选择达克莱伊&克雷色利亚LEGEND身上附加的2个能量，放入放逐区。若对手的宝可梦因这个招式的伤害而【昏厥】，则不将那只宝可梦及其身上附加的卡丢弃，改为放入放逐区。

attacks.t: Move as many damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon as you like to any of your opponent's other Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.tz: 将对手宝可梦身上任意数量的伤害指示物，以任意方式转放到对手的其他宝可梦身上。

me55-C20.rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND. When this Pokémon has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
me55-C20.rulez: 只能和达克莱伊&克雷色利亚LEGEND的另一半一起从手牌放到备战区。这只宝可梦昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, you switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Palkia is affected by a Special Condition.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合（攻击前）可使用1次：让对手将你的1只战斗宝可梦与你的1只备战宝可梦互换。然后，你选择1只防守中的宝可梦，与对手的1只备战宝可梦互换。若帕路奇亚陷入特殊状态，则无法使用这个能力。

attacks.t: You may move all Energy cards attached to Palkia to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. (Ignore this effect if you don't have any Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 可以将帕路奇亚身上附加的能量卡，以任意方式转附于自己的备战宝可梦身上。（若自己没有备战宝可梦，则忽略这个效果。）

me55-C22.rule: Put this card onto your Active Palkia. Palkia LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.
me55-C22.rulez: 将这张卡放在自己的战斗场上的帕路奇亚身上。帕路奇亚LV.X可以使用前一个等级的所有招式、宝可梦力量和宝可梦躯体。

abilities.t: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into Fire Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合（攻击前）可使用任意次：在这个回合内，将喷火龙身上附加的所有能量都视为【火】能量。若喷火龙处于【睡眠】【混乱】或【麻痹】状态，则无法使用这个能力。

attacks.t: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.
attacks.tz: 必须将喷火龙身上附加的2张能量卡丢弃，才可以使用这个招式。

abilities.t: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard 1 Energy card from your hand. Then draw up to 3 cards from your deck. This power can't be used if Delcatty is affected by a Special Condition.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合（攻击前）可使用1次：从手牌将1张能量卡丢弃。然后，从牌库抽出最多3张卡。若优雅猫陷入特殊状态，则无法使用这个能力。

attacks.t: Does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 造成自己战斗宝可梦身上附加的能量数量×10点伤害。

abilities.t: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the 3 other cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. This power can't be used if Metagross is affected by a Special Condition.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合（攻击前）可使用1次：查看自己牌库上方4张卡，从其中选择1张加入手牌。将另外3张卡以任意顺序放回牌库下方。若巨金怪陷入特殊状态，则无法使用这个能力。

attacks.t: You may discard as many Energy cards as you like attached to your Pokémon in play. If you do, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Energy card you discarded.
attacks.tz: 可以将自己场上宝可梦身上附加的能量卡任意张丢弃。若这么做，则造成30点伤害，并且每丢弃1张能量卡，就增加20点伤害。

me55-C3.rule: This Pokémon is both Lightning Metal type.
me55-C3.rulez: 这只宝可梦同时是【雷】和【钢】属性。

abilities.t: When you attach a Plasma Energy from your hand to this Pokémon, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 从手牌将等离子能量附于这只宝可梦身上时，可以选择1只对手的备战宝可梦，与战斗宝可梦互换。

attacks.t: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 给对手的1只备战宝可梦造成20点伤害。（备战宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

me55-C4.rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
me55-C4.rulez: 宝可梦EX昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

me55-C5.text: Discard 2 of the other cards in your hand in order to play this card. If this turn's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and if the attacking Pokémon has Misty in its name, the attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.
me55-C5.textz: 必须将自己的另外2张手牌丢弃，才可以使用这张卡。若这个回合的招式对防守中的宝可梦造成伤害（计算弱点和抗性后），且攻击方宝可梦的名字带有「小霞的」，则对防守中的宝可梦的伤害增加20点。

attacks.t: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to Dark Tyranitar.
attacks.tz: 造成10点伤害，且「暗之班基拉斯」身上每附加1个能量，就增加10点伤害。

attacks.t: Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 给对手的每只宝可梦各造成20点伤害。（备战宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.t: If the Defending Pokémon is Pokémon-ex, this attack does 70 damage plus 50 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若防守中的宝可梦为宝可梦ex，则造成70点伤害再加50点伤害。

attacks.t: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
attacks.tz: 掷3次硬币。造成正面次数×10点伤害。

attacks.t: Flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play (including this one). This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
attacks.tz: 自己场上的每只宝可梦（包括这只）各掷1次硬币。造成正面次数×20点伤害。

attacks.t: Search your deck for up to 3 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择最多3张【雷】能量卡，附于自己的1只宝可梦身上。并且重洗牌库。

attacks.t: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
attacks.tz: 若这只宝可梦身上除了这个招式所需的能量外还多附加了3个以上【雷】能量，则给对手的1只备战宝可梦造成170点伤害。（备战宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）（GX招式在1场对战中只能使用1次。）

me55-C8.rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me55-C8.rulez: 你的TAG TEAM昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may discard a Water Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponents Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 若这只宝可梦是战斗宝可梦，则在自己的回合（攻击前）可使用1次：从手牌将1张【水】能量卡丢弃。若这么做，则在对手的1只宝可梦身上放置6个伤害指示物。

me55-C9.rule: Greninja BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.
me55-C9.rulez: 甲贺忍蛙BREAK保留进化前的招式、特性、弱点、抗性和撤退费用。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, when you put Uxie from your hand onto your Bench, you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌将由克希放置于备战区时，可使用1次：从牌库抽卡，直到自己的手牌变成7张为止。

attacks.t: You may put Uxie and all cards attached to it on the bottom of your deck in any order.
attacks.tz: 可以将由克希及其身上附加的所有卡，以任意顺序放回牌库下方。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, when you put Crobat G from your hand onto your Bench, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，从手牌将叉字蝠G放置于备战区时，可使用1次：在对手的1只宝可梦身上放置1个伤害指示物。

attacks.t: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.
attacks.tz: 令防守中的宝可梦【中毒】。回合之间改为在防守中的宝可梦身上放置2个伤害指示物，而不是1个。

attacks.t: This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 另外给对手的1只备战宝可梦也造成120点伤害。（备战宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.t: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
attacks.tz: 给对手的1只备战宝可梦造成30点伤害。（备战宝可梦不计算弱点和抗性。）

attacks.t: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.
attacks.tz: 在下个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法攻击。

attacks.t: This attack does 40 damage for each of your remaining Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
attacks.tz: 造成自己剩余奖赏卡张数×40点伤害。（GX招式在1场对战中只能使用1次。）

me55-C13.rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
me55-C13.rulez: 你的宝可梦GX昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Flip a coin. If tails, Pikachu does 10 damage to itself.
attacks.tz: 掷1次硬币。若为反面，则皮卡丘也受到10点伤害。

attacks.t: You and your opponent remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon with damage counters on them.
attacks.tz: 双方玩家身上放置有伤害指示物的宝可梦，各移除1个伤害指示物。

attacks.t: If the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage. If it has any damage counters on it, this attack does 10 damage.
attacks.tz: 若防守中的宝可梦身上没有伤害指示物，则造成40点伤害。若身上有伤害指示物，则造成10点伤害。

attacks.t: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将自己牌库上方3张卡丢弃。若其中有能量卡，则将那些卡附于这只宝可梦身上。

attacks.t: Discard all basic Fire Energy or all basic Lightning Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上所有的基本【火】能量，或所有的基本【雷】能量丢弃。造成丢弃的能量卡张数×60点伤害。

me55-C16.rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
me55-C16.rulez: 宝可梦EX昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合（攻击前）可使用1次：将自己的战斗宝可梦与备战宝可梦互换。

attacks.t: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 将这只宝可梦身上附加的能量卡全部丢弃。

attacks.t: Search your deck for up to 5 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择最多5张能量卡，以任意方式附于自己的宝可梦身上。并且重洗牌库。（GX招式在1场对战中只能使用1次。）

me55-C17.rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
me55-C17.rulez: 你的宝可梦GX昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: As long as Gengar is your Active Pokémon, if any of your opponent's Pokémon would be Knocked Out, put that Pokémon in the Lost Zone instead of discarding. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.)
abilities.tz: 只要耿鬼是战斗宝可梦，对手的宝可梦【昏厥】时，就不丢弃，改为放入放逐区。（将那只宝可梦身上附加的卡全部丢弃。）

attacks.t: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a number of Pokémon you find there up to the number of Psychic Energy attached to Gengar. Put the Pokémon you chose in the Lost Zone.
attacks.tz: 查看对手的手牌，从其中选择最多与耿鬼身上附加的【超】能量数量相同的宝可梦。将所选的宝可梦放入放逐区。

attacks.t: Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
attacks.tz: 以任意方式在对手的宝可梦身上放置4个伤害指示物。

me55-C21.text: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player draws a card for each of his or her remaining Prize cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).
me55-C21.textz: 双方玩家各自将手牌放回牌库并重洗。然后，双方玩家各自抽出与自己剩余奖赏卡相同张数的卡。在自己的回合（攻击前）只可以使用1张支持者卡。

attacks.t: This attack does 30 damage times the number of Fairy Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 造成自己所有宝可梦身上附加的【妖】能量数量×30点伤害。

me55-C23.rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends. When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
me55-C23.rulez: 你的宝可梦变成超级进化宝可梦时，你的回合结束。宝可梦EX昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon equal to the number of Water Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.
attacks.tz: 从自己的1只备战宝可梦身上，移除与「闪耀的时拉比」身上附加的【水】能量卡数量相同的伤害指示物。若那只宝可梦身上的伤害指示物比这个数量少，则全部移除。

attacks.t: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).
attacks.tz: 掷与防守中宝可梦身上附加的能量数量相同次数的硬币。若出现1次以上正面，则令防守中的宝可梦【睡眠】【混乱】或【中毒】（由自己选择）。

me55-C24.rule: You can't have more than 1 Shining Celebi in your deck.
me55-C24.rulez: 卡组里最多只能放1张闪耀的时拉比。

abilities.t: As long as Scizor ex's remaining HP is 60 or less, Scizor ex does 40 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
abilities.tz: 只要巨钳螳螂ex的剩余HP在60以下，巨钳螳螂ex对防守中的宝可梦造成的伤害就增加40点（计算弱点和抗性前）。

attacks.t: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Scizor ex by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
attacks.tz: 在下个对手的回合，巨钳螳螂ex受到招式的伤害减少20点（计算弱点和抗性后）。

attacks.t: If the Defending Pokémon is an Evolved Pokémon, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.
attacks.tz: 若防守中的宝可梦为进化宝可梦，则造成50点伤害再加30点伤害。

me55-C25.rule: When Pokémon-ex has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
me55-C25.rulez: 宝可梦ex昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

attacks.t: Choose 1 of your Benched Fusion Strike Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
attacks.tz: 选择自己的1只「连击」备战宝可梦拥有的1个招式，作为这个招式使用。

attacks.t: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 这个招式的伤害不计算对手的战斗宝可梦身上的附加效果。

me55-C26.rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.
me55-C26.rulez: 你的宝可梦VMAX昏厥时，对手拿取3张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: During your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合，可以从自己的牌库选择最多2张卡，加入手牌。并且重洗牌库。（VSTAR力量在1场对战中只能使用1次。）

attacks.t: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon V in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
attacks.tz: 从自己的牌库选择最多3张基本能量卡，以任意方式附于自己的宝可梦V身上。并且重洗牌库。

me55-C27.rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
me55-C27.rulez: 你的宝可梦VSTAR昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Metal Energy cards you find there to this Pokémon. Put the other cards into your hand. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.
abilities.tz: 在自己的回合可使用1次：查看自己牌库上方3张卡，从其中选择任意张【钢】能量卡，附于这只宝可梦身上。将剩余的卡加入手牌。使用这个特性后，自己的回合结束。

attacks.t: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
attacks.tz: 在下个自己的回合，这只宝可梦无法使用招式。

me55-C28.rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
me55-C28.rulez: 你的宝可梦V昏厥时，对手拿取2张奖赏卡。

abilities.t: Whenever you attach a Fire, Water, or Psychic basic Energy card from your hand to Lugia, Lugia's type (color) becomes the same as that Energy card type until the end of the turn.
abilities.tz: 每当从手牌将【火】【水】或【超】基本能量卡附于洛奇亚身上时，直到回合结束为止，洛奇亚的属性变为与那张能量卡相同。

attacks.t: This attack does 10 damage times the number of Energy cards attached to the Defending Pokémon.
attacks.tz: 造成防守中的宝可梦身上附加的能量卡数量×10点伤害。

attacks.t: Discard an Energy card attached to Lugia.
attacks.tz: 将洛奇亚身上附加的1张能量卡丢弃。

attacks.t: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
attacks.tz: 掷2次硬币，若全部为正面，则增加20点伤害。

attacks.t: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
attacks.tz: 这只宝可梦也受到30点伤害。
